content.intro: In this lesson, you will study sealed classes and interfaces with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.

items.title: Controlling inheritance
items.text: Use inheritance for a genuine substitutable relationship, interfaces to express contracts, and composition to combine collaborators. Dynamic dispatch selects an overridden instance method based on the runtime object.
